name: Freshsales
shortInfo: Freshsales is an easy to use sales CRM that helps you build pipeline and close deals effortlessly.
brief: Freshsales is a cloud-based customer relationship management (CRM) solution that helps businesses across different industry verticals to manage their interactions with existing and potential customers.
about:
The Freshsales Reverse ETL connector enables streaming data from a user determined warehouse to the Freshsales platform in an automated manner.

Check more about Freshsales api documentation [here](https://developer.freshsales.io/api/#introduction).
availableSync:
[Accounts](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/reverse_etl/destinations_retl/freshsales/syncs/accounts.html)

This sync can be used to upload accounts details from your data warehouse to the Freshsales platform.

[Contacts](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/reverse_etl/destinations_retl/freshsales/syncs/contacts.html)

This sync can be used to upload contacts details from your data warehouse to the Freshsales platform.

[Deals](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/reverse_etl/destinations_retl/freshsales/syncs/deals.html)

This sync can be used to upload deals details from your data warehouse to the Freshsales platform.
